tools.name: staffsavvy_get_info
tools.description: Return the StaffSavvy software version and API version for this instance. A good first call to check the connection. API: GET /api/v1/info.

tools.name: staffsavvy_list_shifts
tools.description: List shifts on the rota: start and end times, the account, group, venue and task. Filter by event or by field, e.g. start=gte:2026-01-01. API: GET /api/v1/shifts.

tools.name: staffsavvy_get_shift
tools.description: Return one shift by its numeric id. API: GET /api/v1/shifts/{shiftid}.

tools.name: staffsavvy_list_time_entries
tools.description: List recorded time entries (worked hours): start, end, account, group, venue and pay element. Filter by event or by field. API: GET /api/v1/time-entries.

tools.name: staffsavvy_list_absences
tools.description: List absence periods (holiday, sickness and other absences) with their dates and types. Filter by field. API: GET /api/v1/absences.

tools.name: staffsavvy_list_accounts
tools.description: List staff accounts with names, contact details and levels. This returns personal data about staff. API: GET /api/v1/accounts.

tools.name: staffsavvy_list_venues
tools.description: List the venues (sites or locations) set up in StaffSavvy. API: GET /api/v1/venues.

tools.name: staffsavvy_list_groups
tools.description: List the groups (teams or departments) set up in StaffSavvy. API: GET /api/v1/groups.

tools.name: staffsavvy_list_absence_types
tools.description: List the absence types set up in StaffSavvy, e.g. holiday or sickness. API: GET /api/v1/absence-types.
